messages:
maria.k: Heads-up — Acme (enterprise-acme) opened a ticket: after an Okta->SCIM push yesterday a bunch of contractors were removed but still have the "admin" app role in our UI. Customer insists they were deprovisioned from Okta. Can someone help triage? :warning:

devon_s: Thanks Maria. Do we have the SCIM logs for that push? Need the exact payload and delta report. Also was this using SCIM push or the SCIM connector + group push?

maria.k: They said group push from Okta -> our SCIM connector. I pulled the last sync summary from the admin console: `sync_id=sync_2026-03-15_21` and it shows 1,102 updates, 78 deletions. The UI shows ~60 users still with admin role. I'll paste the payload sample from Okta below.

maria.k: ```json
{
  "id": "00u1...",
  "groups": [
    {"id":"00g1...","profile":{"name":"Acme Admins","externalId":"acme-admins:2026"}},
    {"id":"00g2...","profile":{"name":"Contractors","externalId":"acme-contractors:2026"}}
  ],
  "memberships": ["00uX...","00uY..."]
}```

ashley-cs: From the customer message: they map group->app_role via the SCIM group->role mapping in our Console (regex on group.profile.name). Might be that Okta changed how it sets externalId (added suffix) and our mapping only matched exact names without suffix.

samir-eng: Looking at the sync logs, I see this warning repeated: `mapper: group_claim_mismatch: profile.externalId does not match mapped pattern` for many groups. That would cause the user->role connector to skip role removal on the delta apply.

devon_s: Can you paste a couple of those log lines? Also check whether the deprovision action used `operations: remove` vs `operations: deactivate`. If we only handle "deactivate" for role revocation we might miss the remove flows.

samir-eng: Log snippet: ```text
[2026-03-15T21:03:12Z] sync=sync_2026-03-15_21 group=acme-admins externalId=acme-admins mapper=role_regex match=false action=delete user=00uX... skipped_role_cleanup=true
[2026-03-15T21:03:13Z] sync=sync_2026-03-15_21 group=acme-contractors externalId=acme-contractors:2026 mapper=role_regex match=false action=remove user=00uY... skipped_role_cleanup=true
```

maria.k: That's consistent with the customer saying suffix addition happened during a migration. They pushed a CSV->Okta transform earlier this week.

ashley-cs: Short-term: we can manually run a backfill that re-evaluates group membership and reapplies role removals for users in enterprise-acme. I'll coordinate with the customer for a maintenance window. Long-term: update the mapping UI to support `contains` and externalId normalization, and add a safety pass that revokes roles when a user is removed from all mapped groups.

devon_s: Agreed. For the backfill I need a reproducible repro and the API calls. Maria, can you ask Acme to provide one effected user's externalId so I can run locally?

maria.k: Provided one: `user_ext_4590`. Also they allowed us to run a read-only job against their Okta export.

samir-eng: Repro steps for engineers (local):
1) GET current user record: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users?filter=externalId eq \"user_ext_4590\"\"`
2) Verify groups in Okta export and compare to our internal `roles` table
3) Run the cleanup job: `POST /internal/admin/backfills/role-reconcile` with body: `{"enterprise":"enterprise-acme","mode":"revoke_missing"}`

devon_s: I'll run step 1 and share diffs. Also adding a short patch: if mapper fails on externalId regex we should emit an ops alert and set `skipped_role_cleanup=false` flag for the delta apply to force a conservative revoke.

maria.k: Customer okayed a maintenance window Thursday 02:00-03:00 PST. I'll notify them once we have the backfill plan.

ashley-cs: Action items:
- samir-eng: create and run scoped backfill and post results here
- devon_s: add rego/alert for mapper mismatch (low-noise, actionable)
- maria.k: confirm exact list of affected users and schedule

scim-bot: Sync job sync_2026-03-15_21 completed: 1180 records processed, 78 deletions, 45 warnings (mapper mismatches). See /admin/syncs/sync_2026-03-15_21 for full details.

maria.k: Thanks all — please ping me if you need escalation to infra or SRE. :pray:
